official_red_zone_trip_efficiency.definition: Official red-zone trip efficiency is printed on gamebooks. It is stored only on the games that were opened, and it is not averaged into a season rate.
official_red_zone_trip_efficiency.reason: Official red-zone trip efficiency is printed on gamebooks. It is stored only on the games that were opened, and it is not averaged into a season rate.

explosive_pass_20_plays.definition: Complete passes with yards_gained >= 20. Derived from play yards. Not an official explosive label.

explosive_pass_20_rate.definition: Complete passes of 20 or more yards divided by pass plays, including sacks and incompletions.

explosive_rush_10_plays.definition: Run plays with yards_gained >= 10. Derived. Not an official explosive label.

explosive_rush_10_rate.definition: Run plays of 10 or more yards divided by run plays.

explosive_rush_15_plays.definition: Run plays with yards_gained >= 15. Derived. A second threshold already used in this repo's team database, reported separately and not substituted for the 10-yard count.

explosive_rush_15_rate.definition: Run plays of 15 or more yards divided by run plays.

official_explosive_label.definition: Neither the gamebook tables nor nflverse play-by-play carry an official explosive-play label.
official_explosive_label.reason: Neither the gamebook tables nor nflverse play-by-play carry an official explosive-play label.

sacks.definition: Sacks allowed by the defense. A sack is a pass play with sack = 1.

sack_rate.definition: Sacks divided by pass plays allowed by the defense.

qb_scrambles.definition: Run plays with qb_scramble = 1 allowed by the defense. Designed quarterback runs stay in the run count and are not called scrambles.

qb_scramble_rate.definition: Scrambles divided by pass plays plus scrambles. Kneels are not dropbacks.

qb_kneels.definition: Quarterback kneels. Excluded from scrimmage rates and from carry shares. Included in third-down attempts and in the gamebook rushing comparison.

qb_spikes.definition: Quarterback spikes. Excluded from pass-rate denominators. Included in third-down attempts, matching the official gamebook.

two_point_attempts.definition: Two-point conversion attempts. Not scrimmage plays, not targets, and not carries. A missing flag is not counted as zero attempts unless the column was scanned.

shotgun_plays.definition: Scrimmage plays with nflverse shotgun = 1. This is a formation label, not a personnel package.

unknown_shotgun_plays.definition: Scrimmage plays with no shotgun flag. They are not counted as under center.

shotgun_rate.definition: Shotgun plays divided by scrimmage plays that have a shotgun flag.

plays.definition: Run plays scanned for direction allowed by the defense.

unknown.definition: Run plays whose nflverse run_location is missing or outside ['left', 'middle', 'right']. Missing is unknown, not a direction.

plays.definition: Run plays with run_location left allowed by the defense.

share_of_runs.definition: Share of run plays with run_location left. Unknown direction stays in the unknown count and is not recoded.

plays.definition: Run plays with run_location middle allowed by the defense.

share_of_runs.definition: Share of run plays with run_location middle. Unknown direction stays in the unknown count and is not recoded.

plays.definition: Run plays with run_location right allowed by the defense.

share_of_runs.definition: Share of run plays with run_location right. Unknown direction stays in the unknown count and is not recoded.

plays.definition: Run plays scanned for gap allowed by the defense.

unknown.definition: Run plays whose nflverse run_gap is missing or outside ['end', 'guard', 'tackle']. Missing is unknown, not a direction.

plays.definition: Run plays with run_gap end allowed by the defense.

share_of_runs.definition: Share of run plays with run_gap end. Unknown gap stays in the unknown count and is not recoded.

plays.definition: Run plays with run_gap guard allowed by the defense.

share_of_runs.definition: Share of run plays with run_gap guard. Unknown gap stays in the unknown count and is not recoded.

plays.definition: Run plays with run_gap tackle allowed by the defense.

share_of_runs.definition: Share of run plays with run_gap tackle. Unknown gap stays in the unknown count and is not recoded.

pace_plays_per_game.definition: Regulation pass and run plays divided by prior games. Kneels and spikes are excluded, matching scheme scrimmage_plays.

no_huddle_rate.definition: Share of scrimmage plays with no_huddle = 1. Missing flags are excluded, not counted as huddled.
